tagline: Plants, produce and flowers from a family farm in North Vernon since 1998.
about: It all began in 1998 as a way for Kim to stay home with the couple's daughters. Since then Ralph Shatto and Kim Beesley-Shatto have added over an acre of greenhouses for plants and produce year round, plus several acres of outdoor produce and thousands of hanging baskets and mums every year.
highlights: Accepts Farmers' Market gift certificates and Market Bucks

services.description: Thousands of baskets grown every year.
